name: DotField-TS-TW
blurb: Grid of dots that bulge and deflect under cursor proximity.
description: Canvas-rendered particle field with mouse tracking. Dots respond to cursor movement with configurable bulge or push behavior. Includes gradient background, glow effect, optional wave animation, and sparkle effect.
use_when: Interactive background where subtle cursor feedback adds engagement without overwhelming the content.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces where mouse tracking doesn't apply, or when animation should be static.
a11y: Mouse-interactive; no keyboard control or semantic content. No prefers-reduced-motion guard.
